metadata.description: AI Factory region: the v1.25 CLI regions with Bastion Developer, plus the portal-only France Central, Italy North, Norway East and Denmark East.
Naming prefix: 2-16 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
Scale set number, 001-999.
CostCenter tag value.
Object ID of an existing Entra security group for the project team. The deployment never writes to Entra ID.
Display name of that group (tags and RBAC descriptions only).
Technical contact e-mail (technicalAdminsEmail).
AI Search region. Empty or same-as-factory-region means the AI Factory region. No automatic capacity retry.
Microsoft Foundry account, default project and capability host (requires AI Search and Cosmos DB).
Private AI Search.
Private Azure Cosmos DB.
Workspace-based project Application Insights (not private-only without AMPLS).
Azure Machine Learning workspace (requires Application Insights).
AKS compute for Azure Machine Learning (requires Azure Machine Learning).
Standalone private AKS cluster.
Azure Databricks Premium workspace.
Azure Data Factory with managed private endpoints.
Azure Event Hubs Standard (required for Private Link).
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server.
Azure Container Apps environment (requires Application Insights).
AI Search tier for Dev. Free has no private endpoints.
Storage account redundancy for Dev.
Redeploy only: the common VNet exists, so skip 12-networkCommon. Its VNet PUT would delete the subnets added later.
Networking mode (variables.json): private, hybrid (public UI for the IP allow list, private backend) or public (public UI for all, private backend).
Hybrid only: comma-separated IPv4 addresses or CIDR ranges (project_IP_whitelist).
Bastion Developer on the common VNet (free, no admin VM).
Assign the Deploy-Private-DNS-Zones initiative to this subscription.
Billable point-to-site VPN Gateway VpnGw1AZ with Entra authentication (30-45 minutes).
VPN client address pool; must not overlap 172.16.0.0/20.
Billable private Application Gateway WAF_v2. Requires the four inputs below.
Gateway HTTPS frontend hostname covered by the certificate.
Private HTTPS backend FQDN reachable from the VNet.
Versionless https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/<name> URI of an exportable PFX certificate (an identifier, not a secret).
Resource ID of the Key Vault holding that certificate.
